label: Epistemic authority finite omission controls
paraphrase: Six explicit finite interpretations: a goal-relative frame satisfying thin F6, consideration presentation, the ordinary-role definition, the actual-force concession, the goal-relative account and an indifference alternative but neither answerability nor a preference-independent reason; the same evidence with an actually indifferent subject whose ordinary reason lacks actual force; a forceless frame with answerability but no concession or conclusion; an independent frame satisfying concession, answerability and the conclusion; the independent frame with the accuracy aim, which has an indifference alternative and the conclusion without goal-relative force; and the independent frame with an aim met by every preference, which has goal-relative force, the constitutive aim and the conclusion without an indifference alternative.
